_about: Display-only translations of a sage's field, place, journey stops, tags and works (lib/terms.ts): whole phrases or the pieces between their separators and the conjunction ו. The data keeps them in Hebrew, since regions, coordinates, filters and search read them. tests/terms.test.ts fails when a phrase on the roster has no translation.
